reviews.body: ## ✅ Devin Review: No Issues Found Devin Review analyzed this PR and found no bugs or issues to report.

review_comments.body:
Thanks, that reads better. Done in f53d11c. `_parse_choice` now collects the completed calls in a plain `completed` list (the previous call when a new one starts, and the last call on `tool_calls` / `stop`) and builds a single `ChatChunk` from it at the end, so the `flushed` chunk is gone. The existing tests for three calls in one chunk, with the finish in the next chunk and in the same chunk, pass unchanged, as does `tests/test_llm_utils.py`. `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` are clean.

One detail: the chunk now takes `extra` from the delta's `extra_content` also when a call is completed by a new one (before, only the finishing chunk did). Streams that send one call per chunk produce the same chunks as before.
